question: Do nine fixed cap/eta policies cover material single-candidate capacity of the same paid factory records?
scope: All4 families, only pre-fixed G2_CENTER_ENTRY common paid archive. Finite8 and complete offered paid nondominated objective envelopes separately. No new records, parent windows, cap/eta scans or selector.
exactClosure: Convert every stored double to common power-of-two integers. Exhaustive Pareto dynamic programming under max(C),sum(E),sum(W), with exact integer dominance and a record-index witness per state.
metrics: Maximum SINGLE-candidate HV increment over the common archive; secondary references1.25/2.0. No aggregate free injection of the whole oracle front, no claim of uniform selection performance.
qa: Exhaustive small Cartesian fixtures vsDP; independent existing HV comparison on deterministic front samples and every best witness, full decoding all distinct samples. Objective aggregation roundoff reported separately; full QA tolerance inherits existing1e-9 relative contract.
gate: Both instances >=2/4 FULL families have best single gain>=0.1% of archiveHV and nine-policy best gains <half that. Finite reported separately. A pass only permits a new matched SPECIAL/UNIFORM supply diagnostic, never authorizes an online selector or repairs old gates.
interpretation: This can correct the scope of prior nine-policy negatives, not turn them into positives. Only SPECIAL source data available, so no independent four-role supply or novelty claim.
limits: Offline capacity oracle may be expensive and exploit already-paid objective labels. Not an implementable free selector, online FE result, same-time superiority, or a new algorithm.
